datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule (January and February 2022 shown) across Somalia's geographic areas. The data represents spatial classifications of acute food insecurity phases, which are indirect impacts of underlying hazards such as drought. The geographic data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for spatial analysis and mapping.
